title: Creator God
definition: Creator God means that God made all things from nothing by His power, wisdom, and will, and all creation belongs to Him.
summary: God created all things and rules over everything He made.
christFocus: Jesus is the eternal Son through whom all things were created and for whom all things exist.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is Creator of heaven and earth. Creation is not eternal, accidental, or independent. It exists because God willed, spoke, and made it.

As Creator, God owns all things and gives purpose to all things. Creation displays His glory and places humanity under His authority.

The New Testament reveals that all things were created through and for Christ. Creation itself is Christ-centered and will be restored under His reign.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often live as though the world belongs to humanity. Creator God matters because it establishes worship, stewardship, accountability, and purpose.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive creation as God's gift and responsibility. Worship the Creator, care for what He has entrusted, and live as one who belongs to Him.
